versions.content: Trigger transmit data provision : The PduR- DestPduDataProvision of the destination I-PDU is configured to PDUR_- TRIGGERTRANSMIT . When <DstLo>_Transmit is called the <DstLo> module does not copy the data and the PDU Router module shall buffer the I-PDU and wait for the PduR_<DstLo>TriggerTransmit call from the <DstLo> module.
